_help: Copy to staples.json (gitignored) and edit. search = what you'd type in the AH app. After the first 'plan', paste the [id ...] it shows into productId to pin the exact product. everyWeeks: 1 = weekly, 2 = every other week, 4 = monthly. perishable: false lets it stock up when on bonus, up to maxWeeksStock weeks' worth. skipThisWeek: true skips it once. extras: free-text lines added every run.
